Privacy Policy

This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, protect, and share information when you visit our website or use our destination wedding and honeymoon planning services.

Last Updated: January 15, 2025
Effective Date: January 15, 2025

Our Commitment to Transparency: This privacy policy is built on open source principles of transparency and user empowerment. We believe you should know exactly what data we collect, how we use it, and how to control it.

1. Introduction

The Tailored Experience Travel ("we," "our," or "us") operates this website to provide destination wedding and curated honeymoon planning services. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, protect, and share information when you visit our website or use our services.

Contact Information:

Business Name: The Tailored Experience Travel
Website: thetailoredexperiencetravel.com
Email: travel@thetailoredexperiencetravel.com

2. Information We Collect

2.1 Information You Provide Directly

When you use our contact forms or communicate with us, we collect:

  • Contact Information: Name, email address, phone number
  • Event Details: Celebration date, location preferences, service interests
  • Communication Preferences: How you heard about us, communication method preferences
  • Additional Information: Any details you choose to share about your vision, requirements, or questions

2.2 Information Collected Automatically

When you visit our website, we automatically collect certain information through third-party services:

We use third-party services that collect data about your visit. Here's exactly what happens:

3. How We Use Your Information

3.1 Primary Business Purposes

We use the information we collect to:

  • Respond to Inquiries: Answer your questions about our wedding and honeymoon planning services
  • Provide Services: Plan and coordinate your destination wedding or honeymoon experience
  • Vendor Coordination: Share necessary details with hotels, venues, photographers, and other service providers to execute your event
  • Travel Arrangements: Coordinate transportation, accommodations, and activities for you and your guests
  • Communication: Send you relevant information about your event planning process
  • Emergency Assistance: Provide support during your destination event if issues arise
  • Business Operations: Improve our services and website functionality

3.2 Analytics and Improvement

We use automatically collected data to:

  • Understand which content is most helpful to prospective clients
  • Improve website navigation and user experience
  • Optimize our content for search engines
  • Identify technical issues and improve site performance

4. Information Sharing and Third Parties

4.1 We Do NOT Sell Your Personal Information

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties for marketing purposes.

4.2 Third-Party Service Providers

We share information with specific third parties to operate our business and provide our services:

Website and Analytics Services

Google Analytics: Anonymized website usage data for analytics purposes. Google Privacy Policy

Ahrefs: Website performance and SEO analytics data. Ahrefs Privacy Policy

Formspree: Contact form data for processing and delivering your inquiries to us. Formspree Privacy Policy

Wedding and Travel Service Providers

Essential Service Provider Sharing

When planning your destination wedding or honeymoon, we share necessary information with trusted vendors and service providers, including but not limited to:

  • Hotels, Resorts & Venues: Names, dates, group size, room preferences, special requirements, dietary restrictions
  • Transportation Companies: Travel dates, passenger details, pickup/dropoff locations, flight information
  • Wedding Vendors: Event details, timeline, contact information, design preferences (photographers, florists, musicians, etc.)
  • Booking Platforms: Passenger information for reservations, payment details, travel preferences
  • Local Coordinators & Guides: Group details, preferences, emergency contacts, activity requirements
  • Catering & Restaurant Services: Guest count, dietary restrictions, allergies, special occasion details

Important: We only share information necessary to provide the requested services and require vendors to protect your information appropriately. Many vendors are located internationally for destination events.

4.3 International Data Transfers

Because we specialize in destination weddings and international travel, your information may be shared with service providers located outside your home country, including but not limited to:

  • International Hotels and Resorts: For booking accommodations and special arrangements
  • Local Wedding Vendors: Photographers, planners, and vendors in your destination country
  • International Transportation: Airlines, car services, and tour operators
  • Destination Management Companies: Local coordinators who assist with on-ground logistics

Data Protection: When transferring data internationally, we work with reputable vendors and include appropriate data protection requirements in our vendor agreements where possible. However, international vendors may be subject to different privacy laws than your home country.

4.4 Other Sharing Circumstances

We may share your information in these limited circumstances:

  • Legal Requirements: When required by law, court order, or government request
  • Business Protection: To protect our rights, property, or safety
  • Business Transfer: In connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of business assets
  • With Your Consent: When you explicitly agree to additional sharing

5. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

5.1 How We Use Cookies

Our website uses cookies (small text files stored on your device) through third-party services. Here's what happens:

Cookie Transparency

When you visit our site, these cookies are automatically set:

  • Google Analytics cookies track your visit and browsing behavior
  • Ahrefs cookies collect website performance data
  • Formspree cookies may be set when you submit contact forms

We do not set any first-party cookies for tracking purposes.

5.2 Managing Cookies

You have several options to control cookies:

  • Browser Settings: Most browsers allow you to refuse or delete cookies
  • Google Analytics Opt-out: Use the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on
  • Do Not Track: We respect browser "Do Not Track" signals where technically feasible

Note: Disabling cookies may limit website functionality but will not prevent you from contacting us or accessing our services.

6. Data Security and Protection

6.1 Security Measures

We implement appropriate security measures to protect your information:

  • Secure Transmission: All data is transmitted using SSL/TLS encryption
  • Access Controls: Limited access to personal information on a need-to-know basis
  • Third-Party Security: We work only with reputable service providers who maintain strong security practices
  • Regular Updates: We keep our security practices current with industry standards

6.2 Data Retention

  • Contact Inquiries: We retain your contact information for 3 years after your last communication to provide ongoing service
  • Client Projects: If you become a client, we retain project-related information for 7 years for business and tax purposes
  • Vendor Shared Information: Information shared with wedding and travel vendors is subject to their respective retention policies. We recommend reviewing vendor privacy policies for destination events
  • Analytics Data: Google Analytics retains data for 26 months; Ahrefs follows their retention policy
  • Payment Information: Financial details are retained as required by law and accounting practices

6.3 Photos and Visual Content

As a wedding and travel planning service, we may take, receive, or use photos and visual content related to your events. Here's how we handle visual content:

Business Documentation Photos

Event Documentation: Photos taken for business record-keeping purposes (venue setups, logistics documentation, behind-the-scenes planning) may be retained for our business records.

Marketing and Portfolio Use

Consent Required for Marketing Use

We will ONLY use photos of you or your guests for marketing purposes with your explicit written consent.

Marketing use includes:

  • Website portfolio galleries
  • Social media posts (Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, Blog posts)
  • Marketing materials and brochures
  • Professional publications or features
  • Awards submissions or industry showcases

Your Photo Rights:

  • Consent Control: You choose which photos (if any) we may use for marketing
  • Approval Process: We will show you specific photos before any marketing use
  • Anonymization Options: We can blur faces or anonymize photos while showcasing our work
  • Withdraw Consent: You may withdraw consent for marketing use at any time
  • No Requirement: Marketing photo consent is completely optional and does not affect our planning services

Guest Privacy Considerations

We understand that wedding and event photos may include your guests who have not directly consented to photography:

  • Client Responsibility: You are responsible for informing guests about potential photography during your event
  • Guest Requests: If a guest requests removal from marketing materials, we will comply promptly
  • Crowd Shots: General venue or crowd photos where individuals are not clearly identifiable may be used with your consent
  • Focus on Details: We prefer to showcase our work through detail shots, venues, and setups rather than identifiable individuals

Photo Retention Periods

Photo Type Retention Period Purpose
Business Documentation Indefinite Business records and project documentation
Marketing Portfolio (with consent) Indefinite Website, social media, marketing materials
Declined Marketing Photos Deleted within 30 days of project completion Not used; promptly removed from our systems

Third-Party Photographer Coordination

When coordinating with your hired photographers:

  • Separate Agreements: Your photographer has their own contracts and privacy policies
  • Coordination Only: We may share logistics and timeline information with photographers
  • No Photo Ownership: We do not claim ownership of photos taken by your hired photographers
  • Vendor Photos: Photographers/vendors may take photos of our planning work for their own portfolios (subject to their own consent processes)

7. Your Privacy Rights

7.1 Access and Control

You have the following rights regarding your personal information:

  • Access: Request to see what personal information we have about you
  • Correction: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information
  • Deletion: Request deletion of your personal information (subject to legal requirements)
  • Portability: Request a copy of your information in a common format
  • Opt-out: Unsubscribe from marketing communications at any time

7.2 Exercising Your Rights

To exercise these rights, contact us at:

Email: travel@thetailoredexperiencetravel.com
Response Time: We will respond within 30 days of receiving your request
Verification: We may need to verify your identity before processing requests

8. California Privacy Rights (CCPA)

If you are a California resident, you have additional rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act:

  • Right to know what personal information we collect and how it's used
  • Right to delete personal information we have collected
  • Right to opt-out of the sale of personal information (Note: We do not sell personal information)
  • Right to non-discrimination for exercising your privacy rights

9. International Users and GDPR

If you are located in the European Union, you have additional rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR):

  • Lawful Basis: We process your data based on legitimate business interests and consent
  • Data Minimization: We collect only information necessary for our stated purposes
  • Right to Object: You can object to processing of your personal data
  • Data Protection Officer: Contact travel@thetailoredexperiencetravel.com for GDPR-related questions

10. Children's Privacy

Our services are designed for adults planning weddings and honeymoons. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 years of age. If we discover we have collected information from a child under 13, we will delete it immediately.

11. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this privacy policy from time to time to reflect:

  • Changes in our business practices
  • Updates to legal requirements
  • New features or services
  • Changes in third-party services we use

We will notify you of significant changes by:

  • Posting the updated policy on our website with a new "Last Updated" date
  • Sending email notification to our contact list for material changes
  • Providing prominent notice on our website for 30 days after significant changes

12. Questions and Contact Information

If you have questions about this privacy policy or our data practices, please contact us:

Business Hours:
Monday - Friday: 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM PST
Response Time: Within 48-72 hours

Transparency Commitment: This privacy policy reflects our commitment to transparency about data collection and use. We believe in empowering you with clear information about your privacy choices and rights. If anything in this policy is unclear, please don't hesitate to contact us for clarification.

Thank you for trusting The Tailored Experience Travel with your personal information. We are committed to protecting your privacy while providing exceptional wedding and honeymoon planning services.
